name: Shrama Shakthi Scheme
benefit:
Under this scheme, a loan of ₹50,000 will be given to persons belonging to religious minority communities.
Under this scheme, religious minority community entrepreneurs will be trained in artistic and technical skills.
_eligibility_text: 1. The age limit of the applicant should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of the State. 1. Applicants must belong to State Religious Minority Community. 1. Family income from all sources should be within Rs. 3.50 lakh per annum. 1. An applicant or his/her family members should not have availed benefits under any other scheme (Excluding the Arivu Scheme) of the KMDCL in the last 5 years.
